definitions.explanation: The condition of being unable to conceive a child despite regular attempts. Used in medical and general contexts. Composed of {不|ふ} (non-) + {妊|にん} (pregnancy).

examples.japanese: {不妊|ふにん}⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けている→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
{不妊|ふにん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{男女|だんじょ}→男女：03117_danjo⟧⟦どちら→どちら：00927_dochira⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧うる。
examples.english: The cause of infertility can be on either the male or female side.

examples.japanese: {不妊|ふにん}⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対|たい}する→対する：02126_taisuru⟧⟦{公的|こうてき}→公的：06349_kouteki⟧⟦{支援|しえん}→支援：07778_shien⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{拡充|かくじゅう}⟦されて→する：00392_suru⟧きて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Public support for fertility treatments has been expanding.

notes:
USAGE:
{不妊|ふにん} is used as a noun and often as a modifier before other nouns: {不妊|ふにん}⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧ (fertility treatment), {不妊|ふにん}{症|しょう} (infertility as a medical condition). It is a neutral medical term used in both professional and everyday discussion.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不妊|ふにん}⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧ (fertility treatment)
- {不妊|ふにん}{症|しょう} (infertility condition)
- {不妊|ふにん}⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧ (fertility testing)
- ⟦{男性|だんせい}→男性：01655_dansei⟧{不妊|ふにん} (male infertility)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{妊娠|にんしん}→妊娠：12227_ninshin⟧ means pregnancy.
- {不妊|ふにん}⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧ includes procedures such as ⟦{体外|たいがい}{受精|じゅせい}→体外受精：26496_taigaijusei⟧ (in vitro fertilization) and ⟦{人工|じんこう}→人工：11573_jinkou⟧{授精|じゅせい} (artificial insemination).
